map.秒表显示：分 = ⌊毫秒 ÷ 60000⌋，秒 = ⌊(毫秒 % 60000): Stopwatch display: minutes = ⌊milliseconds ÷ 60000⌋, seconds = ⌊(milliseconds % 60000) ÷ 1000⌋, centiseconds = ⌊(milliseconds % 1000) ÷ 10⌋, each two digits zero-padded. Lap: this lap's time = current total elapsed − the previous lap's cumulative total (the first lap equals the total). Countdown input conversion: total milliseconds = (hours × 3600 + minutes × 60 + seconds) × 1000

map.后台标签页的动画帧会被节流，显示可能暂停刷新，但本工具在暂停/计圈时用 perf: Background tabs throttle animation frames, so the display may stop refreshing, but this tool recomputes elapsed time from performance.now() when you pause or record a lap, so the total is correct after returning.
